title: Storm batters northern coast
md:
# Storm batters northern coast

A powerful storm struck the northern coast on 12 March, killing 14 people and leaving 200,000 homes without power, officials said on Thursday.

## Emergency response

The government declared a state of emergency and sent 3,000 troops to help clear roads and reach stranded villages. Prime Minister Ada Okafor visited the worst-hit town of Marlow and promised rapid support.

## Economic impact

Insurers estimate losses of $4.2 billion. The main ports stayed closed for six days, delaying shipments of grain and fuel.

## Outlook

Forecasters expect another system next week, with rainfall of up to 80 mm, and warned that river levels remain high.
